visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight dark hair is shown from the waist up against a neutral, off-white wall. She is wearing a light pink cropped t-shirt and grey joggers. She holds a dusty rose-colored baseball cap with a white 'NY' logo toward the camera. (2) She puts the pink cap on her head and tucks her long hair completely behind her ears, pointing at her jawline with a neutral expression to demonstrate a 'square' face shape. (3) She takes the cap off and uses a thin wooden stick to meticulously create a center part in her hair. (4) Using three fingers to measure, she sections off a front strand of hair on the right side and secures it with a large black hair clip. She repeats this process for the left side. (5) A back-view shot shows her gathering the rest of her hair upward, revealing a pink bow-shaped tattoo on the center of her nape. She secures the top hair with a large gold-toned claw clip. (6) She then takes the two previously sectioned front strands and ties them together with a small black elastic band at the back of her neck, below the main hair pile. (7) She releases the main part of her hair from the claw clip so it falls over the tied strands, effectively hiding the tucked-back appearance. She puts the pink baseball cap back on and adjust her hair. (8) The scene shifts to her holding a smartphone with a decorative floral case, taking a mirror selfie. She poses confidently, tilting her head to show the flattering effect of the hairstyle on her face shape.
